units: <cite ref="Mishnah Menachot 3:2">Men. III, 2</cite> … <he>לא פ׳ … או שפְּתָתָן וכ׳</he> if he omitted to break the meal offering to pieces, … or he broke them (the large pieces) into many small pieces, v. <cite ref="Q02111"><he>פַּת</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Mishnah Menachot 6:4">Ib. VI, 4</cite> (<cite ref="Menachot 75b:2">75ᵇ</cite>) <he>וכולן פּוֹתְתָן</he> Bab. ed., v. <cite ref="Q02174"><he>פָּתִית</he></cite>.
<cite ref="Bamidbar Rabbah 7">Num. R. s. 7</cite> <he>ואוכלין פכסמין ופוֹתְתִין בתוך וכ׳</he> (not <he>ופותין</he>) and we ate biscuits and broke them into the soup; a. fr.
